column1: # Mapping: course chapter -> existing free Killercoda scenarios (Chad M. Crowell)
# Source repo: https://github.com/chadmcrowell/killercoda-scenarios
# Verified against ckad/structure.json (73 items) and cka/structure.json (53 items)
# Format: <chapter-dir> TAB <slug>:<set> TAB ... (max 4 per chapter)
#   set = d -> https://killercoda.com/chadmcrowell/course/ckad/<slug>
#   set = a -> https://killercoda.com/chadmcrowell/course/cka/<slug>
#   set = s -> https://killercoda.com/chadmcrowell/scenario/<slug>   (standalone)
# Chapters with no match are listed at the bottom as GAPS (labs to build ourselves).
# RULE: a Killercoda link goes ONLY into a chapter that already has our own lab
# (the line starting with the test-tube emoji). Chapters without our own lab get
# no Killercoda link, so practice always stays anchored to our own labs.
# EXCLUDED BY DESIGN - Part 0 (preparatory chapters).
# Part 0 comes BEFORE Pods are introduced (chapter 4) and the contents page states
# explicitly that this part has no labs of its own. Every candidate scenario here
# creates Pods or assumes a running cluster, so linking them would break the
# teaching order. Do not re-add. Candidates that were considered and dropped:
#   00-1-net         (none found)
#   00-2-dns         dns-resolution:d          - resolves DNS between Pods
#   00-3-tls         pki-essentials:a, ingress-tls:d - cluster PKI / Ingress + Pods
#   00-4-containers  dockerfile:d, nginx-custom:d   - builds image, runs it as a Pod
#   00-5-linux       linux-services:a, ssh-practice:a, kubelet-status:a - no Pods,
#                    but still need a live cluster; dropped to keep "Part 0 has no labs"
#   00-6-yaml        declarative-pod:a         - creates a Pod
#   00-7-netns       (none found)
#   00-8-vim         (none found)
# EXCLUDED - chapter has no lab of our own, so no Killercoda link either:
#   01  Introduction          (candidates were playground:d, single-node:a, two-node:a)
#   02  Cluster architecture  (candidates were api-resources:a, kubelet-status:a)
# GAPS - no suitable free Killercoda scenario found, build our own later:
# 30            Kubernetes network model + CNI internals
# 35-2-ha       HA control plane, etcd topologies, load balancer
# 35-3-design   cluster design and sizing, IaC
# 40            extension interfaces CNI / CSI / CRI
# 16 (partial)  HPA autoscaling itself - only metrics-server prerequisite exists
